test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Each of the digits in the number 9823415 is arranged in ascending order from left to right. What will be the sum of the digits which are second from the left and second from the right in the new number thus formed?
solution: Given numbers: 9823415 Digits: 9, 8, 2, 3, 4, 1, 5 Sorted → **1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9**
